rules.name_match: case-insensitive exact match on company_name (first pass; see prediction P3)
rules.liveness: only `active` clears G2 (factor 1.0); a deciding page `expired` -> CLOSED (no score); uncertain, unparseable, missing and aggregator-only -> HELD (no score)
rules.aggregator: a posting on an aggregator host (or subdomain) clears G2 only if employer_url is given, is not itself an aggregator, and its own check is active
rules.employer_pages: every non-aggregator URL given for a role must be active
rules.allowlist: a non-aggregator URL whose host is not in ats_hosts.json -> HELD 'source not recognized as employer or ATS' (not checked)
rules.ats_record: Greenhouse job URLs: the public job-board API decides (200 + same id -> active, 404 -> expired -> CLOSED, else uncertain -> HELD); page-checker disagreement is a flag
rules.redirect_chain: non-Greenhouse employer pages: a hop through error=true -> expired -> CLOSED; any employer page: final URL without the job id -> flag only
rules.title_check: ATS title vs candidate title (lowercase word sets); mismatch -> flag only
rules.gate_order: INPUT (fit) -> G1 -> G2a/G2b -> G3; a role stops at its first failed gate

aggregators.indeed.com: Indexes and syndicates postings from employer sites; the page is Indeed's copy, not the employer's record.
aggregators.glassdoor.com: Syndicated listings; the page state reflects Glassdoor's copy, not the employer's ATS.

aggregators.simplyhired.com: Job search engine over postings from other sites; a copy, not the source.

not_verified: Whether a company sponsors SOC 15-2051 specifically. CSV approval counts are company-wide; the title check only looks at top_job_titles_sponsored. [TODO: DATA SOURCE] SOC-coded DOL LCA disclosure data.
Company matching is exact (case-insensitive). A G1 miss may be a naming difference (e.g. 'Airbnb' vs 'AIRBNB INC'), not a non-sponsor.
The timeline formula reflects a general understanding of the 90-day OPT unemployment limit. It is not legal advice; confirm dates with the school's international student office.
BLS wage is a national OEWS estimate shared by all O*NET sub-occupations of 15-2051 (a group wage), not an offer. role_quality carries weight 0 in the scorer, so it does not change any decision.
Funding values come from the CSV; they were not re-checked against new SEC filings.
An `active` result means the page loaded and showed a visible apply control. It does not prove the employer is still reviewing applications.

The aggregator list and the employer allowlist are hand-made rules. A job board missing from both is held as unrecognized; a careers domain missing from the allowlist is held too, even if it is the real employer.
Only Greenhouse has an ATS record check. Lever, Ashby, Workday and SmartRecruiters pages are allowlisted but still decided by the page checker.
Whether employer_url is really the same job as posting_url is your-input; this run does not compare the two pages' text.
